The assistant also re-ran the checker and re-audited rewritten claims against artifacts before running the high-tier adversary review, including checking the unexpected WORKLOG.md change, adding missing hops for unreached ADRs, creating a directory index at designs/decisions/README.md, and editing designs/README.md, docs/README.md, and AGENTS.md. The assistant then checked the agent-dispatch review command help to understand how to run the governed adversary review (agent-dispatch review --class adversary) on the rebuilt tree, and prepared for the high-tier Phase 5 governed cross-vendor adversary review on the rebuilt docs (working tree vs HEAD). After the last edits, the agent re-ran cheap deterministic checks (scoped adversary) and consulted the advisor before declaring done. The agent then confirmed deterministic checks clean, consulted the advisor again, and gathered final stats using git diff --stat (excluding WORKLOG.md) and called the todo tool twice. A second pass completed 6/6 regions without degradation, applying legitimate majors while rejecting history-as-current and chunk-misattributed findings; separately, an adversary run on `dispatch-adversary`/`gpt-5.6-sol` (cross-vendor) degraded with 9/16 regions unreviewed and `deadline_exceeded`, flagged as a Phase 5 FAIL, requiring triaging live-doc hits and retrying unreviewed leaves. [project:github-com-rasatpetabit-cachelane]
